facts.label: Healing potions moved
facts.value: Superior and Major Healing Potions are now First Aid crafts. The old Alchemy healing-potion recipes are gone.

facts.label: Dyes
facts.value: Alchemists make Cerulean, Magenta and Viridian Dye from new scarce herbs (Frilled Lichen, Rosecap and Stranglevine). Other crafts use them: the Runecloth Bag now takes 4 Magenta and 2 Cerulean Dye.

facts.label: New materials
facts.value: Alchemists turn Pyrite into Sulfuric Acid and can transmute Legionite Bars from Heavy Thorium Bars and Fel Crystals.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Mana Well at skill 20, Fermenter at 140 (blueprint from Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron) and Alchemy Laboratory at 300. The Mana Well buff matches Blessing of Wisdom and does not stack with it.

facts.label: Profession title
facts.value: Crafters who reach 300 can earn a certification item that unlocks a title such as 'the Alchemist'. Alliance players get it from the Azeroth Commerce Authority.

facts.label: Professions window
facts.value: Professions have their own window, opened with K. Recipe lists can be searched and filtered, and you can track a recipe in the objectives frame.

facts.label: Skill ranks
facts.value: Apprentice up to 75, Journeyman up to 150 (skill 50, level 10), Expert up to 225 (skill 125, level 20) and Artisan up to 300 (skill 200, level 35). 300 is the cap.

facts.label: Alliance trainers
facts.value: Icy Veins lists Artisan Alchemy trainers at Feathermoon Stronghold (Feralas) and the Emerald Sanctuary (Felwood), and Expert trainers for several professions in Dalaran (Alterac Mountains).

facts.label: Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Fill Waylaid Crates (found in the world or bought on the Auction House) and hand the sealed crates to Marcy Baker of the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge. Craftsman's Writs add reputation.

facts.label: Favor recipes
facts.value: Elixir of the Grizzly needs Alchemy 300, Honored and 240 Favor. Lower-skill recipes include Elixir of the Phalanx (Alchemy 250) and Elixir of Cunning (Alchemy 275).

facts.label: Legacy
facts.value: The first time you reach 150, 225 and 300 in a craft you earn 1 Legacy point each; a character can spend up to 16 points under the launch cap. Perks include Working Overtime (better skill-up chance) and Performance Bonus (extra Merchant's Favor).

facts.label: Fire protection recipe (Classic baseline)
facts.value: Classic 1.12: the Greater Fire Protection Potion recipe drops from Firebrand Pyromancers and Firebrand Invokers in Blackrock Spire and needs Alchemy 290.

facts.label: Flasks
facts.value: Flasks still have to be made at an Alchemy Lab, but the placeable Alchemy Laboratory camp object (Alchemy 300) means no trip to Scholomance.

facts.label: 30-minute elixirs
facts.value: New Favor elixirs last 30 minutes: Grizzly (+25 Strength, +2% crit), Owl (+25 Intellect, +2% crit), Cunning (+25 Agility and Intellect), Greater Cleric's (+40 healing), Greater Mageblood (20 mana per 5 s) and Phalanx (+400 health, +500 armor).

facts.label: New potions
facts.value: Major Frenzy Potion (+80 attack power for 30 s), Major Mender's Potion (+88 healing for 30 s) and Potion of Elemental Purging (+105 spell damage against Elementals for 5 minutes).

facts.label: Rage potions
facts.value: Rage, Great Rage and Mighty Rage Potions now work for Druids as well as Warriors.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Where the Alchemy Laboratory blueprint drops, which decides who can make flasks away from Scholomance.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether protection potions keep the 2-minute duration seen in beta data (1 hour in Classic).

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: What the Elixir of Greater Firepower recipe makes in the live game; beta data named the result Elixir of Holy Power.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: The final Azeroth Commerce Authority recipe list and prices, and what Artisan crates pay in Favor.
